Description.SourceString:
We doff our caps to you. You walked into Umbral Sands from Dowdun Reach, looked at the sands, Scorch and giant dragon and thought "you know what? I'm going to do some farming". You're as based as the people who, likewise, were confronted by all of those things and promptly built a giant wooden house. 

Of all the things to grow, we can actually understand the barrel cactus. Native to this region, it's also full of moisture - thus the 'barrel' - which is reasonably integral to the game you are playing.
